# Steven Vanden Heuvel

> Principal Designer on payments and checkout, most recently at PayPal, with 18 years of responsive web and design systems work in B2B publishing behind it. Based in Aurora, IL in the Chicago area, open to remote work. This site is his portfolio: stevendesignco.com, published as Steven Design Co.

Steven worked on PayPal's Merchant Enablement team from December 2025 to August 2026. In his first six months he shipped 20+ merchant checkout proposal packages on weekly sprint cycles for top global brands, work that supported PayPal's priority of greater checkout prominence to grow TPV. On his own initiative he built a browser brief form and a Figma plugin that cut merchant flow setup from most of a day to 10 to 15 minutes across a 38-merchant program. He also builds with agentic tooling, Claude Code and Cursor, inside product work, including a consumer checkout mapping board presented to senior leadership.

Before PayPal he spent 18 years at MTG Media Group, growing from Senior Art Director to VP and Creative Director. He led a 6 person team and built responsive web products and design systems for 7 brands serving 128,000+ B2B professionals. He has won 4 Jesse H. Neal Awards, including the 2017 Neal Award for Best Website, and was a Grand Neal Finalist, top 4 nationally. He also takes on select freelance work through Steven Design Services LLC.

## Case studies

- [PayPal: Becoming the Default at Checkout](https://www.stevendesignco.com/work/paypal): Merchant checkout proposals on weekly sprints, a consumer checkout mapping project, and the Merchant Flow Builder tooling.
- [Plate: Website Redesign](https://www.stevendesignco.com/work/plate): The digital platform for chefs and foodservice professionals. Won the 2017 Jesse H. Neal Award for Best Website.
- [Project Blackbird](https://www.stevendesignco.com/work/blackbird): An interactive oral history of the restaurant that transformed Chicago's dining. Grand Jesse H. Neal Finalist.
- [Alt-Meat](https://www.stevendesignco.com/work/alt-meat): Brand identity, magazine, and responsive news site, designed in under 8 weeks.
- [Meatingplace](https://www.stevendesignco.com/work/meatingplace): Responsive rebuild of MTG's flagship daily news site for U.S. meat and poultry professionals.
